newsitem.title: INDIA: India L&T Apr-Dec 96 new orders up 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: India L&T Apr-Dec 96 new orders up 20 pct.

text.p: New orders booked by Indian construction and engineering giant Larsen & Toubro Ltd (L&T) from April to December 1996 show a 20 percent rise in value terms over the same period a year ago, a top official said.

"As of now, we have a 20 percent order book growth in the nine months of the current year," Yeshwant Deosthalee, L&T's senior vice president (finance) and a board member, told Reuters in an interview on Thursday.
He said the order backlog at the end of December was in excess of 43.0 billion rupees.
"But expectations of these people could have been higher," Deosthalee said, referring to analysts at some securities firms who have recommended their clients should sell L&T shares.
Analysts said the order book growth had slowed down from more than 35 percent recorded in 1995/96 (April-March).
They said the slowing of order book growth in the second half of fiscal 1996/97 (April-March), was largely reflective of a slowdown in various industries and financing problems.
